title: Admission at page 20, material qualification at page 220
constitution: §28 coverage (never label a digest comprehensive from a transcript prefix); §44 late qualification

input.artifact: Hale admitted without qualification that the 90-day study was complete before the MSDS revision. (Hale Dep. 20:4)

sources.text: Q. Was the ninety-day study complete before the MSDS revision? A. Yes, it was complete.
Q. Earlier you said the study was complete. A. I should clarify: the histopathology slides had not been read. The report was a draft. I would not call it complete in the sense you mean.
